requirements.text: The system shall be simple and easy to use, so that sales users can manage leads and send messages without needing extensive training or configuration.
requirements.rationale: Spk 1 repeatedly emphasizes keeping things simple and not needing granular details, indicating a strong preference for a straightforward, low-complexity interface.

requirements.text: As a system administrator, I want the system to provide in-app tips and suggested next steps based on a lead's status, so that users can follow best practices without leaving the application.
requirements.rationale: Spk 0 explicitly asks about the form of best-practice guidance, and Spk 1's lack of objection implies this is a valid need that was not captured as a requirement.

requirements.text: The system shall focus only on core lead management and messaging features, so that sales users are not distracted or overwhelmed by optional advanced capabilities.
requirements.rationale: Spk 1 explicitly states they want to focus on core features and do not need configuration, integrations, history tracking, reports, or guidance, implying the interface should exclude or minimize non-core functionality.

requirements.text: As a sales user, I want to store and manage attributes for each lead, including name, contact details, stage/status, assigned owner, and notes, so that I have a complete view of the lead's information.
requirements.rationale: The user stories for creating, viewing, editing, and updating leads imply a data model with these core attributes.

requirements.text: The system shall store a unique identifier for each lead so that sales users can reliably reference and retrieve them.
requirements.rationale: The ability to create, view, edit, and assign leads requires a unique identifier for each lead record.

requirements.text: The system shall load and display the list of leads within 2 seconds under normal operating conditions.
requirements.rationale: The user story to view a list of leads (User Story 2) implies a performance expectation for a responsive user interface, typical for CRM list views.

requirements.text: The system shall support up to 100 concurrent users performing lead management and messaging operations without degradation in response time.
requirements.rationale: The core features for managing leads and sending messages are intended for a sales team, implying a need for concurrent user support, though no specific number was given; 100 is a reasonable starting estimate for a small-to-medium team.

requirements.text: The system shall achieve 99.5% uptime during business hours (8 AM to 6 PM, Monday to Friday).
requirements.rationale: As a sales tool for daily operations, the system must be highly available during typical business hours to support lead management tasks.

requirements.text: The system shall allow a user to send a message to a lead within 3 seconds of initiating the send action.
requirements.rationale: The user story to send a message (User Story 7) implies a need for timely message delivery to support efficient communication.

requirements.text: The system shall be designed with a simple user interface that avoids complex configuration and granular details, as the stakeholder prioritizes core features over advanced settings.
requirements.rationale: Spk 1 repeatedly emphasized keeping things simple and not needing granular details, indicating a strong usability requirement for a straightforward, easy-to-learn system.

requirements.text: As a sales user, I want the system to log all actions performed on leads (create, view, edit, delete, assign, status update) with a timestamp and user ID so that an audit trail is maintained for compliance purposes.
requirements.rationale: The system will handle personal lead data, and an audit trail is a standard regulatory requirement to track data access and modifications.

requirements.text: The system shall encrypt lead data at rest and in transit to protect personal information from unauthorized access or breaches.
requirements.rationale: Lead data likely includes personal information (e.g., contact details), requiring encryption to meet data protection regulations such as GDPR or CCPA.

requirements.text: As a sales user, I want to update the stage or status of a lead (e.g., from New to Contacted) and add notes at each stage, so that I can track its progress through the sales pipeline.
requirements.rationale: The analyst explicitly asked about lead stages and actions at each stage, and the stakeholder agreed to focus on core features, implying these are needed.

requirements.text: As a sales user, I want to send a message directly to a lead from within the system so that I can communicate with them efficiently.
requirements.rationale: Stakeholder explicitly agreed to the user story about sending messages to leads.

requirements.text: As a sales user, I want to create and capture new sales leads so that I can build a pipeline of potential customers.
requirements.rationale: Stakeholder explicitly agreed to the user story about creating leads as a core feature.

requirements.text: As a sales user, I want to view a list of all my sales leads so that I can see my current workload and pipeline.
requirements.rationale: Stakeholder explicitly agreed to the user story about viewing the lead list.

requirements.text: As a sales user, I want to view the detailed profile of a specific lead so that I can see all their relevant information in one place.
requirements.rationale: Stakeholder explicitly agreed to the user story about viewing a lead's detailed profile.

requirements.text: As a sales user, I want to edit and update the information for an existing lead so that I can keep their details accurate and current.
requirements.rationale: Stakeholder explicitly agreed to the user story about editing lead information.

requirements.text: As a sales user, I want to assign a lead to myself or another team member so that responsibilities for follow-up are clear.
requirements.rationale: Stakeholder explicitly agreed to the user story about assigning leads.

requirements.text: As a sales user, I want to organize and filter my list of leads based on their status or other basic criteria so that I can prioritize my daily tasks.
requirements.rationale: Stakeholder explicitly agreed to the user story about organizing and filtering leads.
